Yet fragmented toolchains, implicit domain conventions, and specialized correctness criteria make this knowledge difficult to convert into reliable learning experience-a challenge we call the sci
articles.summary: 科学代码库以可执行模型、方法与工具承载数十年知识，但工具链碎片化、领域约定隐式、正确性标准专门化，难以转化为可靠的学习经验。ScienceIDE 将全球科学代码库改造为 agent 可学习的环境，为科学智能体提供训练与评测基础。

articles.title: An Empirical Study of Harness Design for Coding Agents

articles.title: Confidence Comes from Experience: Experiential Confidence Estimation from Reasoning to Agents

articles.title: ProgramDistill: From Interactive Web Apps to Verifiable Reference-Guided SWE Tasks

articles.title: Agora: Git as Shared Memory for Collective AutoResearch
articles.excerpt: Autonomous research loops such as AutoResearch show that one coding agent can improve a training setup unattended. articles.title: JEPA-Anything: Learning Predictive Models across Different Worlds
